digest.component_or_area: composer title validation and cross-facade test corpus
propositions: Whitespace-only titles (spaces, tabs, newlines) are accepted by current validation using `if not title:` and must be rejected consistently across CLI, library, and MCP facades.
Titles with surrounding whitespace but real content (e.g., '  hi  ') must be accepted and stored byte-identically without silent trimming.
Create-path tests lack coverage for empty and >255-character title rejection; only edit-path tests exist.

Cross-facade parity tests use only simple ASCII values; a curated corpus covering leading dashes, quotes, backslashes, newlines, emoji, NFC/NFD forms, and 1000+ character strings must round-trip byte-identically or be rejected identically across all three facades.
The pre-existing `U+2192 (→)` → `->` substitution in `create_core`/`edit_core` must be retained and excluded or explicitly documented as a normalization exception in the corpus.
